data.name: Narendra
data.gender_notes: Narendra is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: King of men; lord of men
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit nara, 'man', + indra, 'lord, king' — 'lord of men'. Its root is Sanskrit nara + indra. A classical Sanskrit name; borne by Swami Vivekananda. Narendra is a Sanskrit name meaning “King of men; lord of men”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Narendra expresses “King of men; lord of men”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit nara, 'man', + indra, 'lord, king' — 'lord of men'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Narendra total 39, reducing to 3. Number 3 is associated with expression, creativity and optimism.
